blocks.zh: 執行階段與交接階段
blocks.en: Execution and Handover Stages

blocks.zh: 本節內容導覽 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: Execution Stage — 執行階段
blocks.en: Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 執行階段核心任務
blocks.en: Core Tasks of the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 執行階段（Execution Stage）是整個技術轉移流程的關鍵驗證環節。主要工作包括：
blocks.en: The Execution Stage is the key verification step of the whole technology transfer process. The main work includes:

blocks.zh: 完成所有 PPQ（製程性能確認）批次的執行
blocks.en: Executing all PPQ (process performance qualification) batches

blocks.zh: 提交 法規申請文件（Regulatory Filing）
blocks.en: Submitting the regulatory filing

blocks.zh: 確保所有作業準備就緒，達到 RU 商業生產條件
blocks.en: Ensuring all operations are ready to meet the RU's commercial manufacturing conditions

blocks.zh: 多重 Stage Gate 機制
blocks.en: Multiple Stage Gates

blocks.zh: 本階段可設置多個 Stage Gate（關口審核），例如：工程批前、PPQ 前、PPQ 後各設一個審核點，確保每個關鍵里程碑均達標才繼續推進。
blocks.en: Several Stage Gates (gate reviews) can be set in this stage, for example one before the engineering batch, one before PPQ and one after PPQ, so that each key milestone is met before the project moves on.

blocks.zh: 執行階段各職能活動與交付成果對照表
blocks.en: Execution Stage: Functional Activities and Deliverables

blocks.zh: 執行階段九大職能分工
blocks.en: Nine Functions in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 執行階段涉及九個職能部門的協同運作，各部門的關鍵交付物包括：
blocks.en: The Execution Stage involves nine functional departments working together. Their key deliverables include:

blocks.zh: 流程部門：製程驗證報告、VMP 結案
blocks.en: Process: process validation report, VMP closure

blocks.zh: 分析部門：批次放行檢測、穩定性計畫啟動
blocks.en: Analytical: batch release testing, start of the stability program

blocks.zh: 製造部門：工程批 + PPQ 批次執行記錄
blocks.en: Manufacturing: execution records for the engineering batch and PPQ batches

blocks.zh: 法規部門：提交法規申請文件
blocks.en: Regulatory: submission of the regulatory filing

blocks.zh: 品質部門：物料與產品放行
blocks.en: Quality: release of materials and product

blocks.zh: 比喻：執行階段如同「上場考試」
blocks.en: Analogy: the Execution Stage is the "final exam"

blocks.zh: 前幾個階段是備考（Planning、Readiness），執行階段就是正式上場應試——PPQ 是最終考試，必須一次性展現所有準備成果。所有職能部門同步運作，缺一不可。
blocks.en: The earlier stages (Planning, Readiness) are the study period; the Execution Stage is the real exam. PPQ is the final test, and it must demonstrate all the preparation in one go. All functions work in step, and none can be missing.

blocks.zh: Business — 商業職能
blocks.en: Business

blocks.zh: 商業部門的執行階段角色
blocks.en: The Business Function's Role in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 商業部門在本階段的核心任務是確保 上市策略（Launch Strategy） 與 PPQ 進度、法規提交時程同步對齊。與供應鏈部門協同，確認 PPQ 批次用途（臨床供應 vs. 商業用途）及預估市場需求量。
blocks.en: The Business function's core task in this stage is to keep the launch strategy aligned with the PPQ progress and the regulatory submission timeline. Working with Supply Chain, it confirms the intended use of the PPQ batches (clinical supply vs. commercial use) and the estimated market demand.

blocks.zh: 多重 Stage Gate 時機
blocks.en: Timing of the Multiple Stage Gates

blocks.zh: 工程批前：確認所有準備工作就緒
blocks.en: Before the engineering batch: confirm that all preparatory work is complete

blocks.zh: PPQ 前：驗證工程批結果是否滿足進入 PPQ 的條件
blocks.en: Before PPQ: verify that the engineering batch results meet the conditions for entering PPQ

blocks.zh: PPQ 後：若有製程變更或新風險，需額外審核
blocks.en: After PPQ: if there are process changes or new risks, an additional review is needed

blocks.zh: 通過 Steering Committee 核准法規申請後，方可進入交接階段。
blocks.en: Once the Steering Committee approves the regulatory filing, the project can move into the Handover Stage.

blocks.zh: TT PM 執行階段三大任務
blocks.en: Three Main Tasks of the TT PM in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 清除障礙：確保所有文件核准、變更控制關閉、培訓完成
blocks.en: Remove obstacles: ensure all documents are approved, change controls are closed and training is complete

blocks.zh: 駐廠計畫（Person-in-Plant Program）：安排 SU 人員駐在 RU 現場，提供技術支援與培訓
blocks.en: Person-in-Plant Program: place SU staff at the RU site to provide technical support and training

blocks.zh: TT 報告：核准技術轉移報告，記錄 TT 協議中所有要求已完成
blocks.en: TT report: approve the technology transfer report, documenting that all requirements in the TT agreement have been completed

blocks.zh: 比喻：Person-in-Plant 如「教練進場」
blocks.en: Analogy: Person-in-Plant is like "the coach joining the match"

blocks.zh: SU 技術人員駐在 RU 現場，就像球隊教練坐在替補席——不是親自上場踢球，但隨時提供指導、即時解決技術問題，大幅降低執行風險。
blocks.en: SU technical staff on site at the RU are like a coach on the bench: they do not play on the pitch themselves, but they give guidance and solve technical problems immediately, greatly reducing execution risk.

blocks.zh: Process — 製程職能
blocks.en: Process

blocks.zh: 製程職能在執行階段的核心責任
blocks.en: Core Responsibilities of the Process Function in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 監督 PPQ 及出貨驗證執行
blocks.en: Oversee the execution of PPQ and shipping validation

blocks.zh: 每班至少一名製程人員在場（建議）
blocks.en: At least one process person present on every shift (recommended)

blocks.zh: SU × RU 跨職能偏差調查
blocks.en: Joint SU × RU deviation investigations

blocks.zh: PPQ 完成後發行製程/出貨/清潔驗證報告
blocks.en: Issue the process, shipping and cleaning validation reports after PPQ is completed

blocks.zh: 偏差處理黃金原則
blocks.en: Golden Rule for Deviation Handling

blocks.zh: 製程真正失敗時，製程 + 品質須諮詢法規部門，評估 PPQ 狀態是否可繼續推進，並立即由 TT PM 向 Steering Committee 回報。
blocks.en: When a process genuinely fails, Process and Quality must consult Regulatory to assess whether the PPQ can continue, and the TT PM must report to the Steering Committee immediately.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Application at a Taiwan CDMO

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 PPQ 中，製程人員需確認每個班次均有技術人員到場，並在 PPQ 前將 Readiness 階段的所有製程知識整合進批次記錄及 SOP，避免知識斷層。
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling PPQ, process staff must confirm that technical personnel are present on every shift, and must incorporate all process knowledge from the Readiness stage into the batch records and SOPs before PPQ, to avoid knowledge gaps.

blocks.zh: Analytical — 分析職能
blocks.en: Analytical

blocks.zh: 分析職能的全面運作
blocks.en: The Analytical Function's Full Scope of Work

blocks.zh: 執行階段的分析部門需執行比商業生產更密集的檢測計畫：
blocks.en: In the Execution Stage the Analytical department runs a more intensive testing program than in commercial manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 物料放行檢測 / 製程中樣品 / 成品 / 清潔樣品
blocks.en: Material release testing / in-process samples / finished product / cleaning samples

blocks.zh: 公用系統及環境監測（視需要）
blocks.en: Utilities and environmental monitoring (as needed)

blocks.zh: 穩定性樣品包裝與管理
blocks.en: Packaging and management of stability samples

blocks.zh: PPQ 期間的加強測試是為了積累足夠驗證數據；達標後，商業生產可啟用降低版測試計畫（Reduced Testing Program）。
blocks.en: The enhanced testing during PPQ is meant to accumulate enough validation data; once the criteria are met, commercial manufacturing can adopt a Reduced Testing Program.

blocks.zh: Engineering — 工程職能
blocks.en: Engineering

blocks.zh: 工程職能角色轉換
blocks.en: The Engineering Function's Changing Role

blocks.zh: 進入執行階段，工程部門從前期的「主導設備確認」轉為支援角色——重點是處理 PPQ 過程中設備/廠房相關的偏差、變更控制，並協助驗證取樣與數據分析。
blocks.en: On entering the Execution Stage, Engineering shifts from leading equipment qualification in the earlier stages to a supporting role: the focus is on handling equipment- and facility-related deviations and change controls during PPQ, and assisting with validation sampling and data analysis.

blocks.zh: Manufacturing — 製造職能
blocks.en: Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 工程批的雙重功能
blocks.en: The Dual Purpose of the Engineering Batch

blocks.zh: 工程批（Engineering Batch）在特定條件下可兼具兩種用途：
blocks.en: Under certain conditions an Engineering Batch can serve two purposes:

blocks.zh: 臨床供應：GMP 條件下執行，產品可供臨床使用
blocks.en: Clinical supply: executed under GMP conditions, so the product can be used clinically

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次：若 VMP 及 PPQ 協議事先核准，可同時計入 PPQ 批次（原料供應受限時特別有用）
blocks.en: PPQ batch: if the VMP and PPQ protocol are approved in advance, it can also count as a PPQ batch (especially useful when raw material supply is limited)

blocks.zh: SU 參與工程批的重要性
blocks.en: Why SU Participation in the Engineering Batch Matters

blocks.zh: 建議 SU 團隊在工程批期間到場參與，確保知識在 SU → RU 之間有效轉移，並在正式 PPQ 前即時修正 SOP 與批次記錄。
blocks.en: The SU team is advised to be on site during the engineering batch to ensure effective knowledge transfer from SU to RU, and to correct the SOPs and batch records promptly before the formal PPQ.

blocks.zh: Regulatory — 法規職能
blocks.en: Regulatory

blocks.zh: 法規職能執行階段重點
blocks.en: Regulatory Priorities in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 依提交追蹤表（Submission Tracker）主動管理文件撰寫、審閱與定稿
blocks.en: Proactively manage document drafting, review and finalization using the Submission Tracker

blocks.zh: 持續更新 MAH 法規部門，確保執行階段新資訊納入申請文件
blocks.en: Keep the MAH regulatory team updated so that new information from the Execution Stage is included in the filing

blocks.zh: Steering Committee 授權提交前，需完成 CMC 內容的跨職能全面審閱
blocks.en: Before the Steering Committee authorizes submission, complete a full cross-functional review of the CMC content

blocks.zh: PAI 高風險項目準備
blocks.en: Preparing for High-Risk PAI Topics

blocks.zh: PAI（藥品上市前查廠）的高風險主題包括：PPQ 期間的偏差事件、稽查機關歷史查廠關注重點（特定廠址、製程類型、產品類別或公司）。法規部門需協助建立 Storyboard，確保申請文件與廠房文件的聲明一致性。
blocks.en: High-risk topics for a PAI (pre-approval inspection) include deviation events during PPQ and the historical inspection focus of the authorities (specific sites, process types, product categories or companies). Regulatory should help build a Storyboard to ensure the statements in the filing are consistent with the facility documents.

blocks.zh: Quality — 品質職能
blocks.en: Quality

blocks.zh: 品質部門：執行階段的核心把關者
blocks.en: Quality: the Core Gatekeeper of the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 品質部門貫穿執行階段全程，關鍵職責：
blocks.en: Quality is involved throughout the Execution Stage, with these key responsibilities:

blocks.zh: 物料放行與批次最終處置（Batch Disposition）
blocks.en: Material release and final batch disposition

blocks.zh: 核准所有 PPQ 文件（協議、報告、批記錄、偏差調查）
blocks.en: Approve all PPQ documents (protocols, reports, batch records, deviation investigations)

blocks.zh: 結案 TT 品質風險評估
blocks.en: Close out the TT quality risk assessment

blocks.zh: 執行 模擬查廠（Mock Inspection），提前找出 PAI 可能被查核的問題
blocks.en: Conduct a Mock Inspection to identify in advance the issues a PAI might raise

blocks.zh: Mock Inspection 的策略價值
blocks.en: Strategic Value of the Mock Inspection

blocks.zh: 模擬查廠是一種主動式品質管理工具，可在正式 PAI 前發現文件不一致、記錄缺失等問題，大幅降低查廠風險。PAI 通過可視為執行階段的正式結束點。
blocks.en: A mock inspection is a proactive quality management tool. Before the actual PAI, it can reveal inconsistent documents, missing records and similar problems, greatly reducing inspection risk. A successful PAI can be regarded as the formal end point of the Execution Stage.

blocks.zh: Sourcing / Supply Chain — 採購與供應鏈
blocks.en: Sourcing / Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 供應鏈的執行階段三大輸出
blocks.en: Three Outputs of Supply Chain in the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: 確立供應商：完成供應商資格確認
blocks.en: Establish suppliers: complete supplier qualification

blocks.zh: 明確供應鏈路徑：建立清晰的物流與儲存標準
blocks.en: Define the supply chain route: set clear logistics and storage standards

blocks.zh: 生產計劃標準：為商業生產制定排程與計劃基準
blocks.en: Production planning standards: establish scheduling and planning baselines for commercial manufacturing

blocks.zh: 執行階段最佳實踐與補充建議
blocks.en: Execution Stage Best Practices and Additional Recommendations

blocks.zh: 執行階段十大最佳實踐重點
blocks.en: Ten Key Best Practices for the Execution Stage

blocks.zh: SME 提前到場：在工程批前即部署技術專家，確保即時支援
blocks.en: SMEs on site early: deploy technical experts before the engineering batch to ensure immediate support

blocks.zh: 工程批前完成培訓：操作人員須在使用驗證物料前完成實際操作訓練
blocks.en: Complete training before the engineering batch: operators must finish hands-on training before using validation materials

blocks.zh: 試跑（Trial Run）：用水批或廢料進行模擬，驗證設備就緒度
blocks.en: Trial run: simulate with water batches or scrap material to verify equipment readiness

blocks.zh: 批次前準備會議：執行前再次確認製程要求、控制策略
blocks.en: Pre-batch meeting: reconfirm the process requirements and control strategy before execution

blocks.zh: 滾動式法規審閱：文件完成章節後即開始審閱，避免瓶頸
blocks.en: Rolling regulatory review: start reviewing each section as soon as it is drafted, to avoid bottlenecks

blocks.zh: 充足的開發測試數據：確保前期數據足以支撐 PPQ 推薦參數
blocks.en: Sufficient development and test data: ensure the earlier data adequately support the PPQ recommended parameters

blocks.zh: 完整批次記錄指引：批記錄須清楚涵蓋所有操作要求
blocks.en: Complete batch record guidance: the batch record must clearly cover all operational requirements

blocks.zh: 實操培訓優先：操作員資格認定（OQ）優於閱讀式培訓
blocks.en: Hands-on training first: operator qualification (OQ) takes priority over read-only training

blocks.zh: 製程控制策略驗證：PPQ 數據應對照控制策略評估，至少涵蓋關鍵參數
blocks.en: Process control strategy verification: evaluate PPQ data against the control strategy, covering at least the critical parameters

blocks.zh: Handover 前 Stage Gate：確認所有職能一致認可製程可進入商業生產
blocks.en: Stage Gate before Handover: confirm that all functions agree the process is ready for commercial manufacturing

blocks.zh: 自我檢核：你的廠是否做到了？
blocks.en: Self-Check: Does Your Site Do This?

blocks.zh: PPQ 前是否有正式的 Readiness Meeting？
blocks.en: Is there a formal Readiness Meeting before PPQ?

blocks.zh: 工程批是否安排 SU 技術人員到場？
blocks.en: Are SU technical staff arranged to be on site for the engineering batch?

blocks.zh: 操作員是否完成實際設備操作訓練（非僅閱讀 SOP）？
blocks.en: Have operators completed hands-on equipment training (not just reading SOPs)?

blocks.zh: Stage Gate 是否有跨職能簽核記錄？
blocks.en: Does the Stage Gate have a record of cross-functional sign-off?

blocks.zh: Handover Stage — 交接階段
blocks.en: Handover Stage

blocks.zh: 交接階段的本質
blocks.en: The Essence of the Handover Stage

blocks.zh: 交接階段是 TT Team 將產品正式移交給 RU 後轉移營運團隊（Post-Transfer Operations Team）的過程，核心目標是確保 RU 具備獨立商業生產能力。
blocks.en: The Handover Stage is the process by which the TT Team formally hands the product over to the RU's Post-Transfer Operations Team. The core goal is to ensure the RU has the capability for independent commercial manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 風險評估是活的文件
blocks.en: The Risk Assessment Is a Living Document

blocks.zh: 貫穿整個 TT 專案的風險評估，在交接階段仍持續更新。交接的平滑程度取決於 TT Charter 中定義的端點，不同 TT 類型的要求各有差異。
blocks.en: The risk assessment that runs through the whole TT project continues to be updated during the Handover Stage. How smooth the handover is depends on the end point defined in the TT Charter, and requirements differ among TT types.

blocks.zh: 比喻：交接如「師徒出師」
blocks.en: Analogy: handover is like an apprentice "graduating"

blocks.zh: TT Team 是師傅，RU 後轉移團隊是徒弟。交接階段就是正式的「出師典禮」——師傅確認徒弟已具備獨立作業的能力，完整交付所有工具（文件、知識、供應鏈），然後退場。
blocks.en: The TT Team is the master and the RU post-transfer team is the apprentice. The Handover Stage is the formal graduation ceremony: the master confirms that the apprentice can work independently, hands over all the tools (documents, knowledge, supply chain) and then steps back.

blocks.zh: 交接階段各職能活動與交付成果對照表
blocks.en: Handover Stage: Functional Activities and Deliverables

blocks.zh: 交接階段關鍵交付物一覽
blocks.en: Key Deliverables of the Handover Stage

blocks.zh: TT PM：完整產品交接（Full Handover）+ Stage Gate 核准
blocks.en: TT PM: Full Handover of the product + Stage Gate approval

blocks.zh: 製程：CPV 計畫與報告模板
blocks.en: Process: CPV plan and report templates

blocks.zh: 品質：商業品質管理系統 + 商業品質協議
blocks.en: Quality: commercial quality management system + commercial quality agreement

blocks.zh: 法規：法規核准文件
blocks.en: Regulatory: regulatory approval documents

blocks.zh: 製造：完成培訓的人員
blocks.en: Manufacturing: trained personnel

blocks.zh: CPV 計畫的重要性
blocks.en: Why the CPV Plan Matters

blocks.zh: 持續製程驗證（Continued Process Validation, CPV）是 ICH Q10 要求的生命週期驗證方法，在交接階段由製程部門建立，確保商業生產的長期一致性監控。
blocks.en: Continued Process Verification (CPV) is a lifecycle validation approach required under ICH Q10. The Process department establishes it in the Handover Stage to ensure long-term consistency monitoring of commercial manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 商業職能交接任務
blocks.en: Business Handover Tasks

blocks.zh: PPQ 完成後，商業部門檢視與 RU 的商業合約，確認商業產能規劃可行，並制定因應新產品需求的資源計畫（人員、設備）。
blocks.en: After PPQ is completed, the Business department reviews the commercial contract with the RU, confirms that commercial capacity planning is feasible, and prepares a resource plan (people, equipment) for the new product's demand.

blocks.zh: TT PM 的收尾責任
blocks.en: The TT PM's Closing Responsibilities

blocks.zh: TT PM 在交接階段確認 TT Charter 所有要素均已落實，記錄經驗教訓（Lessons Learned），協助 RU 在正式移交前完成流程改善，並正式結案。
blocks.en: In the Handover Stage the TT PM confirms that all elements of the TT Charter have been implemented, records the Lessons Learned, helps the RU complete process improvements before the formal transfer, and formally closes the project.

blocks.zh: 製程職能：交接後的延續支援
blocks.en: Process Function: Continued Support After Handover

blocks.zh: 製程部門人員在交接階段是知識轉移（KT）的關鍵角色，可能在後轉移常規生產期間持續提供技術支援，並主導 PPQ 識別出的製程改善及相關變更控制。
blocks.en: Process staff are key players in knowledge transfer (KT) during the Handover Stage. They may continue to provide technical support during post-transfer routine manufacturing and lead the process improvements identified in PPQ and the related change controls.

blocks.zh: 分析職能：穩定性計畫的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Analytical Function: Key Role in the Stability Program

blocks.zh: 確保新產品正式納入 RU 的穩定性測試計畫，監督穩定性協議的執行，並調查穩定性測試中出現的 OOS（超規範結果）及偏差事件。
blocks.en: Ensure the new product is formally included in the RU's stability testing program, oversee execution of the stability protocol, and investigate OOS (out-of-specification) results and deviation events arising in stability testing.

blocks.zh: 工程職能的交接任務
blocks.en: Engineering Handover Tasks

blocks.zh: 整合確認期間的設備操作經驗教訓，識別設備改善、升級或更換需求，並在商業生產開始前完成變更控制與法規影響評估。
blocks.en: Consolidate the lessons learned on equipment operation during integrated qualification, identify needs for equipment improvement, upgrade or replacement, and complete change control and regulatory impact assessment before commercial manufacturing begins.

blocks.zh: 製造職能的商業生產就緒確認清單
blocks.en: Manufacturing Checklist for Commercial Readiness

blocks.zh: RU 製造部門在交接前須確認具備以下所有商業生產能力：
blocks.en: Before handover, the RU Manufacturing department must confirm that it has all of the following commercial manufacturing capabilities:

blocks.zh: 清潔作業（Cleaning）
blocks.en: Cleaning

blocks.zh: 產品切換（Product Changeovers）
blocks.en: Product Changeovers

blocks.zh: 樣品採集與提交（Sample Pulling & Submission）
blocks.en: Sample Pulling & Submission

blocks.en: Media Fills

blocks.en: Change control management

blocks.en: Maintenance

blocks.en: Batch Operations

blocks.zh: 警告：交接不足的風險
blocks.en: Warning: Risks of an Inadequate Handover

blocks.zh: TR65 第 8.12 節案例研究說明，若製造與供應鏈的交接不足，商業生產可能出現嚴重問題。完整的操作準備確認是防止此類風險的關鍵。
blocks.en: The case study in TR65 section 8.12 shows that if the handover between Manufacturing and Supply Chain is inadequate, serious problems can arise in commercial manufacturing. A complete confirmation of operational readiness is key to preventing such risks.

blocks.zh: 法規職能的交接責任
blocks.en: Regulatory Handover Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 溝通法規核准的預期時程，及時預警潛在延誤
blocks.en: Communicate the expected timeline for regulatory approval and give early warning of potential delays

blocks.zh: 審閱促銷材料及醫療資訊，確保與產品標籤一致性
blocks.en: Review promotional materials and medical information to ensure consistency with the product labeling

blocks.zh: 確立 RU 的法規事務負責人，建立長期溝通機制
blocks.en: Identify the RU's regulatory affairs lead and set up a long-term communication mechanism

blocks.zh: 評估上市後申請（Post-Approval Submissions）的效率化機會
blocks.en: Evaluate opportunities to streamline post-approval submissions

blocks.zh: 品質部門的交接收尾工作
blocks.en: Quality Department Closing Work at Handover

blocks.zh: 品質管理審查流程：建立涵蓋 RU 與 SU 的品質管理審查機制
blocks.en: Quality management review process: establish a quality management review mechanism covering both the RU and the SU

blocks.zh: 品質協議更新：確保涵蓋商業生產所有相關事項
blocks.en: Quality agreement update: ensure it covers all relevant matters for commercial manufacturing

blocks.zh: 文件結案：關閉所有 TT 文件（變更控制、驗證報告、偏差、CAPA）
blocks.en: Document closure: close all TT documents (change controls, validation reports, deviations, CAPA)

blocks.zh: 知識整合：將執行階段的經驗教訓納入後轉移團隊的未來培訓
blocks.en: Knowledge integration: incorporate the lessons learned in the Execution Stage into the post-transfer team's future training

blocks.zh: 供應鏈的交接要點
blocks.en: Key Handover Points for Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 交接前須整合執行階段的經驗教訓，更新：
blocks.en: Before handover, integrate the lessons learned in the Execution Stage and update:

blocks.zh: 排程規劃中的設備與人力標準
blocks.en: Equipment and manpower standards in scheduling and planning

blocks.zh: 採購前置時間與訂購數量
blocks.en: Procurement lead times and order quantities

blocks.zh: 供應計畫與採購計畫（考量商業需求與放行時效）
blocks.en: Supply plan and procurement plan (considering commercial demand and release lead times)

blocks.zh: 交接階段最佳實踐與補充建議
blocks.en: Handover Stage Best Practices and Additional Recommendations

blocks.zh: 交接階段七大最佳實踐
blocks.en: Seven Key Best Practices for the Handover Stage

blocks.zh: 正式交接會議：提供完整交接包（文件、製程理解、經驗教訓），涵蓋設備、時程、預測、採購等
blocks.en: Formal handover meeting: provide a complete handover package (documents, process understanding, lessons learned) covering equipment, schedule, forecasts, procurement and more

blocks.zh: 長期培訓計畫：強調實際操作培訓，而非僅限課堂教學
blocks.en: Long-term training program: emphasize hands-on training rather than classroom teaching alone

blocks.zh: 經驗教訓會議：正式討論成功與改進點，記錄根本原因供未來專案參考
blocks.en: Lessons learned meeting: formally discuss successes and areas for improvement, and record root causes for reference in future projects

blocks.zh: 商業需求全面確認：系統軟體、庫存、採購計畫、預防性維護等全部就緒
blocks.en: Full confirmation of commercial needs: system software, inventory, procurement plans, preventive maintenance and so on are all ready

blocks.zh: 知識有效轉移：通過培訓、批記錄更新、SOP 修訂、模擬作業確保知識落地
blocks.en: Effective knowledge transfer: ensure knowledge takes hold through training, batch record updates, SOP revisions and simulated operations

blocks.zh: 產能符合商業需求：貫穿整個 TT 持續監控商業預測與實際週期時間
blocks.en: Capacity meets commercial demand: continuously monitor commercial forecasts and actual cycle times throughout the TT

blocks.zh: 製程受控移交：確保移交的製程符合所有驗收標準且在控制策略規定的操作範圍內
blocks.en: Controlled process handover: ensure the transferred process meets all acceptance criteria and stays within the operating ranges set by the control strategy

blocks.zh: Operations Director 視角：交接的真正風險
blocks.en: Operations Director's View: the Real Risks of Handover

blocks.zh: 多數 TT 失敗不是在執行階段，而是在交接後的商業生產初期暴露問題。關鍵風險點：
blocks.en: Most TT failures are not exposed in the Execution Stage but in the early period of commercial manufacturing after handover. Key risk points:

blocks.zh: 後轉移團隊缺乏實操經驗（僅有閱讀訓練）
blocks.en: The post-transfer team lacks hands-on experience (read-only training)

blocks.zh: 產能評估未考慮共用設備的競爭需求
blocks.en: Capacity assessment ignores competing demand on shared equipment

blocks.zh: Lessons Learned 僅書面記錄、未真正整合進培訓
blocks.en: Lessons Learned are only documented and not truly integrated into training

blocks.zh: 供應鏈前置時間在商業初期出現意外斷鏈
blocks.en: Supply chain lead times break down unexpectedly in early commercial manufacturing

blocks.zh: 比喻：交接會議如「飛行前後艙交接」
blocks.en: Analogy: the handover meeting is like a "cockpit crew handover"

blocks.zh: 航空業的駕駛艙交接有嚴格的口頭確認程序——不能只是「留個紙條」。TT 交接會議同樣應有結構化的確認清單，確保接手的後轉移團隊完全了解飛機（製程）的當前狀態與注意事項。
blocks.en: Cockpit handovers in aviation follow a strict verbal confirmation procedure; leaving a note is not enough. The TT handover meeting should likewise use a structured checklist, so the post-transfer team taking over fully understands the current state of the aircraft (the process) and what to watch for.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 中文總結
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 最終提醒：風險評估貫穿始終
blocks.en: Final Reminder: Risk Assessment Runs Throughout

blocks.zh: TR65 強調，風險評估是「活的文件（Living Document）」，必須貫穿整個 TT 專案，直到正式交接完成。交接後的商業生產仍需持續透過 CPV 監控製程狀態。
blocks.en: TR65 stresses that the risk assessment is a "Living Document" that must run through the whole TT project until the handover is formally complete. After handover, commercial manufacturing still requires continued monitoring of the process state through CPV.
